caption_L2L3: The san antonio spurs have had a steady increase in revenue from $80 million in 2001 to $140 million in 2011. After this, they saw a steep increase in revenue up to $19 million in2015/16 before another spike to $255 million in 2016/17. Since then, the revenue has stayed relatively constant, growing to $280 million in 2018/19.
